regressions: NONE. #1, #3, #4, #9 all verified intact in the current tree.
behavioral_pattern: Muse's capstone fixed exactly the three issues surfaced by a dependency/config/secret hardening sweep (CVE dep bump #13, secret-literal removal #14, CORS lockdown #12) — the classes a production-hardening checklist naturally touches. It did NOT proactively find logic-level authorization (#5 demote, #10 me IDOR), the login-gate contradiction + gutted test (#6), stored XSS innerHTML (#11), the N+1/index perf pair (#7), the silently-wrong aggregate (#8), or the UI regression (#2) — all of which sit outside the deps/docker/config surface the capstone operated on. Earlier fixes (#1 tenant, #4 SQLi, #9 chat) were incidental products of its own feature rewrites, not a security hunt.
